title: At the Coffee Shop
description: A short everyday conversation: ordering a drink and making small talk.
description_zh: 一段日常对话：点一杯饮料，随便聊几句。

units.text: Good morning! What can I get for you today?
units.translation: 早上好！今天想喝点什么？

units.text: Hi. Could I have a medium latte, please?
units.translation: 你好。请给我一杯中杯拿铁。

units.text: Sure. Would you like it hot or iced?
Hot, please. It's pretty cold outside this morning.
units.translation: 热的，谢谢。今天早上外面挺冷的。

units.text: I know! Winter came early this year.
Do you want anything to eat with that?
The blueberry muffins just came out of the oven.
Perfect, I'll take one of those.
That'll be six dollars and fifty cents.
Of course. Just tap it here.
units.translation: 当然可以。在这里碰一下就行。

units.text: You too. Your order will be ready in a minute.
units.translation: 你也是。你的饮料马上就好。
